name: Manguri
source:
In a strange world, you can tell girls how to have fun. You get to watch the animated results. Afterward, your batgirl guide will say what kind of person you are.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403170830/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wnm.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
在陌生的世界里，你可以告诉女孩们如何玩得开心。你可以观看动画结果。之后，你的蝙蝠女导游会告诉你你是一个什么样的人。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403170830/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wnm.htm]李的欢乐屋[/url]]
